notes.content:
[h2]Hello, gamers. The 0.9.11 patch is here![/h2]


[b]Note[/b]: 📢 indicates changes based on community feedback!

[h3]🎮[b]Major Changes[/b][/h3]


[h3][b]Game Ending Added[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756618/d9e44cde902643dee51150caa8cf58952a69915c.png[/img]
[spoiler]Explore the deepest parts of the dungeon to rescue the princess![/spoiler]


[h3][b]Enhanced Room List[/b][/h3]
In MyArcade, you can now join rooms that are waiting or in progress by pressing the Party Mode button. If the game is in progress, you will wait for a while and then enter as soon as it becomes available. You can cancel the waiting process if needed.


[h3][b]Boss Battle Improvements[/b][/h3]
Previously, when a player died in a boss battle, each player would lose one heart. Now, one heart is consumed only when all players die. When a player dies, they float around the map as a bubble, and if another player rescues them, they will revive without consuming a heart. 
Each phase of the boss battle will now drop energy when the boss is defeated.


[h3][b]UI Improvements[/b][/h3]
All UI elements in My Arcade have been unified for a consistent look and feel.


[h3][b]Bonus Game Improvements[/b][/h3]
If you die in a bonus game, you will drop the coins you collected. You must collect all coins to earn 1/3 of a heart.


[h3]🛠[b]Bug Fixes and Gameplay Improvements[/b][/h3]
[list]
💬 Fixed an issue where the animation would occasionally skip when selecting a game cartridge in Party Mode
💬 Fixed the problem of cartridges being created twice
💬 Fixed the issue where the proposal button would not reappear after rejecting a game suggestion
💬 Adjusted the health of minions in boss battles
[/list]

[h3]👾[b]Known Issues[/b][/h3]
[list]
📢 The mini-game 'Slime Pang' has been temporarily removed from Party Mode due to issues. It is still available in My Arcade.
💬 TV footage has been replaced with a temporary image.
💬 There is an issue where rejoining a game in progress in another arcade may cause you to enter as the first character.
[/list]

Please send us your feedback on the new system introduced today. You can easily share your thoughts via comments or the 'Send Feedback' feature within the game!

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.9.10
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, Gamers. The 0.9.10 Patch is Here![/h2]

[b]Note[/b]: 📢 Indicates community feedback!

[h3]🎮[b]Major Changes[/b][/h3]
💬 Unlock System Added



[h3][b]Unlock System Added[/b][/h3]

You can now grow your MyArcade through the unlock system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756618/444a6c376c28ec7f502f6cace488d822fcb436d4.png[/img]
Mini-Game Unlocks
Play [Mystery Cartridge] in Party Mode, then return to MyArcade to find a large box containing a new game console. These game console boxes can be opened with energy obtained in Party Mode. Unopened game console boxes will appear as [Demo Cartridges] in Party Mode, with the blue energy locked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756618/d3edc71d3d7bd02e0fa46ae92da65222665794c2.png[/img]
Decorate MyArcade Wallpaper and Flooring
Talk to [Master Bong] using Arcade Coins earned in Party Mode to purchase and decorate wallpaper and flooring.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756618/f790b4842b6d83f796260cda283feacbcaecabc1.png[/img]
Unlock Player Emotions
Talk to [Master Bong] using Arcade Coins earned in Party Mode to purchase player emotions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756618/9093cec9b83733f32fecb5bbdf979a06252da0bf.jpg[/img]
Stage Length and Difficulty Changes
Initially, 2 stages and a boss stage will appear. Clearing the boss stage unlocks 3 more stages and another boss stage. Each time you rescue a kidnapped friend, longer stages are unlocked. The difficulty of the boss stages increases progressively.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756618/f30548b21c2fa933558b66a08c3d7ff1bfe8b8da.jpg[/img]
Energy System Improvements
The third energy has been changed to blue energy. Only the best players can obtain blue energy. If even one player obtains the blue energy, the mini-game is cleared unconditionally. Blue energy is initially locked and is unlocked when the game console box is opened in MyArcade.

[h3][b]New Special Cartridges Added to Party Mode[/b][/h3]

New cartridges are available for selection in Party Mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756618/ddd4589fffa5a9f3340284ebeafa012c83906ec3.png[/img]
Coin Cartridge
Additional coins pour out in mini-games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756618/67e25216cb9c22234e45298c61231414f70baa72.png[/img]
Revenge Cartridge
Appears when a mini-game is failed. Successfully taking revenge deals double damage to the arcade machine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756618/496b1fb59b8942493589c9a1fa26334a4e2e7faa.png[/img]
Mystery Cartridge
A new cartridge appears.

Demo Cartridge
Games found in Party Mode but not yet unlocked in MyArcade appear as Demo Cartridges.

[h3][b]Vending Machine Added[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756618/faa18eabd6cbaf6e3cdec62b4aef12651d707740.jpg[/img]
If you run out of hearts while playing Party Mode, try using the vending machine!
It offers drinks that replenish hearts, including some that permanently increase the number of hearts.

[h3][b]Practice Mode Added to Mini-Games in MyArcade[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756618/2662305ca8d97a2773f08bc65b424513bd138eed.png[/img]
Difficulty selection and stage effect options have been added to mini-games.
Challenge yourself at the difficulty that suits your skill!

[h3]🛠[b]Bug Fixes and Gameplay Improvements[/b][/h3]
[list]
💬 Tutorial content and images improved
💬 MyArcade internal improvements and optimization to match the unlock system
💬 Changed so that extra hearts do not grant lives at 1/3 and 2/3 increments
💬 Jukebox songs now remain consistent

[/list]

[h3]👾[b]Known Issues[/b][/h3]
[list]
📢 The mini-game 'Slime Pang' has been temporarily disabled in Party Mode due to issues but is still playable in MyArcade.
💬 TV videos have been replaced with temporary images.

💬 Occasional animation skips when selecting game cartridges in Party Mode
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Note 0.9.7
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, gamers! The 0.9.7 patch has arrived![/h2]

[b]Note[/b]: The 📢 symbol indicates improvements based on community feedback!

[h3]🎮[b]Major Changes[/b][/h3]
[list]
💬 Party Mode Overhaul
[/list]

[h3][b]Party Mode Overhaul[/b][/h3]
The previous individual heart system did not align with the cooperative and competitive direction of the arcade party. We have switched to a shared heart system where all players share hearts, and we've added an energy system. Here are the changes.


[h3][b]Party Mode Start Button[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756618/f724feab596773430aa0335194716fb8271150e7.jpg[/img]
To improve accessibility to party mode, we've made it possible to start party mode directly through the UI. Enjoy party mode from anywhere in your arcade without any complicated processes!


[h3][b]Difficulty System Modification[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756618/bff05c00b1968e6d5646c43719d3e234a8bfc0d9.jpg[/img]
Our development team aims to transform Arcade Party into a challenging game for true gamers, not just an easy game anyone can beat. As part of this, we've added a player-customizable difficulty system and adjusted the difficulty of minigames and boss fights. Now, you'll start at the easiest difficulty and progress to higher difficulties based on your skill level.


[h3][b]Energy System[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756618/295d11a1b0fd2994235ce013a913299d4edf49fe.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756618/da72c11a19390bc1dbcce9a8822df9f46c68e0b1.jpg[/img]
The scoring evaluation system has been replaced with an energy system. You will earn energy based on the scores you achieve in minigames. If the total energy collected by you and your teammates falls below the threshold, you will take damage. if it exceeds it, you will deal proportional damage to the arcade machine.

A player can collect a maximum of three energy units.


[h3][b]Coin Item[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756618/00b9034cae13349f0536babd22e4d89a2acb2bb4.jpg[/img]
During the bonus game, not only will you gain lives, but you'll also be able to collect coins. We plan to add items that allow you to collect arcade coins during other minigames as well, so stay tuned for more exciting updates!


[h3]🛠[b]Bug Fixes and Gameplay Improvements[/b][/h3]
[list]
💬 Party mode rules adjustment for the minigame ‘Dino Safari’
💬 Party mode rules adjustment for the minigame ‘Dino Internet’
💬 Party mode rules adjustment for the minigame ‘Step It Up’
💬 Party mode rules adjustment for the minigame ‘Suika Party’
💬 Fixed an issue where character portraits were displayed too brightly
[/list]

[h3]👾[b]Known Issues[/b][/h3]
[list]
📢 The minigame 'Slime Pang' has issues in party mode and has been temporarily disabled, but it's still playable in my arcade
💬 During the ‘Speedy’ stage effect, blocks overlap in the minigame ‘Robot Factory’
💬 The issue where the party mode proposal UI does not disappear during the start of party mode
[/list]

Please send us your feedback after playing the new party mode. You can share your thoughts easily via comments or the 'Send Feedback' feature in the game!

Your feedback is very valuable to the development team. Thank you always.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.9.0
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, gamers! The 0.9.0 patch has arrived.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756618/f22b5ebe388c3190a8fa42df991399bb963c1c57.png[/img]

[b]Note[/b]: 📢 indicates a change that reflects the feedbacks of the community!


[h3]🎮[b]Major Changes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added ‘My Arcade’
[*] New ‘Public Lobby System’ added
[*] My Room revamped
[*] Added emoticon feature (including character voices!)
[*] Player card added
[*] Personal heart system added
[*] Carry system added
[*] ‘Arcade Party Mode’ background modification and production improvement
[*] Steam achievements added
[/list]

[h3][b]Public Lobby System[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756618/e270e60f1f3a5d2bee87f6c7a8d5607132000923.png[/img]
Now you can easily access other players' arcades without an invitation code! The ‘Join Other Arcades’ option in the system menu displays arcades that are currently being accessed by players. Enjoy games with new friends!


[h3][b]Jukebox & Figure cabinet[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756618/659d2ca02e0778f3f9a8ee2875779002589b53ab.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756618/8405b5af022114613f947d2a3ec8ee3d1ae96367.jpg[/img]
You can display figures and OSTs obtained through gacha in My Arcade and enjoy them with others.


[h3][b]Emoticon Feature[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756618/3caaf8a90f428ae7c50eef808ea163ed80ba927d.jpg[/img]
Enhance in-game communication with various emoticons! More emoticons will be available through gacha and other methods in the future.


[h3][b]Player Card & Personal Heart System[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756618/1ba2ffdc05451895e970f746e1f275de8a507595.jpg[/img]
Now you can see the scores you have earned and remaining hearts at a glance through the player card at the bottom of the screen.

Moreover, the system has been changed from sharing hearts among all team members to each player having their own hearts.


[h3][b]Carry System Addition[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756618/bbe6cbb480ffe1240e83d0cd63d45dc7d10f11e9.jpg[/img]
Previously, there were specific conditions required for success in each game, and once a player met those conditions, any additional points were meaningless. This often led to a lack of tension before the game ended.

Now, points earned beyond the cutline in minigames are transferred to other players. Earn lots of points and carry your team to victory!


[h3][b]Steam Achievements Added[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756618/36baa7312ca967ae714c4ec2fd0b227e7a78043a.jpg[/img]
New challenges with Steam achievements have been added! Achieved milestones and their requirements can be checked on the game page on Steam and on the achievements board in My Arcade.


[h3]🚀[b]Roadmap Achievement Status and Upcoming Updates[/b][/h3]
It's been 7 months since we announced the roadmap to you in June 2023. Since then, we've been busy with everything from minor bug fixes to adding and improving minigames, final boss battles, endings... and today, the addition of My Arcade and the new lobby system that many players have been looking forward to! It's been a breathless half year. But I want to say that our journey is just beginning!

notes.title: Happy Holidays!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756618/109af3b4dbca3add655dfcabf17897a91d613590.jpg[/img]
Dear 'Arcade Party' Gamers, Happy holidays! Are you enjoying this festive season?

We wish you and your family a season filled with happiness and joy, and hope you have Happy Holidays!

'Arcade Party' has grown significantly this year, thanks to your constant encouragement and love. Since the start of early access in February, we have introduced 5 mini-games of various genres, terrifying boss battles, and cute and cool costumes. In addition, we've added many large and small elements to the game and fixed numerous bugs, all based on your valuable feedback!

We can't forget about the events where we met many of you, can we? We were delighted to meet many gamers and hear various opinions at PlayX4, Gamescom and G-STAR.

As Christmas approaches, we want to express our gratitude to you. We sincerely thank you.


[h2]New Expectations for 2024! More Mini-Games and a Public Lobby System[/h2]

In the new year, we are preparing to bring even more joy to you! We plan to add more mini-games than this year and introduce a public lobby system that will allow gamers from all over the world to play together. Please look forward to 'Arcade Party' continuing to grow with you in the new year!

Oh, and we almost forgot to mention – we secretly took some photos of the arcade currently under construction, curious about what updates await you. Let's check them out together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756618/ea46dd296e9afc20fca4b58cb377936bb1372679.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756618/d343fb6f03305331547de736eeeab72b8a73a6e4.png[/img]
Our protagonists seem busy today! Not only herding sheep and goats back to the barn but also gathering food while avoiding terrifying zombies... It looks like they need your help!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756618/eb4bd121538ec8778ad2b0e48d4d7db590d59b79.png[/img]
Wow.. That's a really impressive Christmas tree! I heard rumors about a new arcade opening near the shopping mall, and it seems almost ready to welcome you – we are so excited!

Did you notice the photo of our protagonists greeting you in front of the tree? That's right! The next patch will include a feature for expressing emotions. Moreover, imagine how cute it will be when these expressions come with voices in Korean, English, and Japanese!


[h2]And Official Release on Steam and Switch![/h2]

We are working hard to meet more of you through an official release on Steam and the Nintendo platform within the first quarter. Soon, you'll be able to comfortably enjoy the game sitting on the sofa with friends or family in front of the TV!


[h2]To a Bigger World, New Challenges! ‘One-Coin Challenge’ and ‘Ranking System’![/h2]

In addition to the features mentioned above, we are also diligently developing additional features like the ‘One-Coin Challenge,’ a score-keeping mode where you can test your skills, and a ‘Ranking System’ to compete with numerous players worldwide based on the scores obtained in ‘One-Coin Challenge’. We are doing our best to bring these features to you as soon as possible, so please look forward to them!

We hope you have a warm and happy Christmas and year-end. We look forward to the new year with you with joy.

Happy holidays!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756618/98a18d0f0995468fd593f706a8ded3014e098d63.jpg[/img]

From Team 'Arcade'

Still, Arcade Party is a game in development and getting better and better.
